approaches_tried.approach: Harvester-resolution ladder treats an explicitly-set LEAN_PLAN_COMPLIANCE_HARVESTER override as just another cascading rung (existence-checked like the other three), falling through to sibling/repo-relative/source-store rungs when the override path does not exist
approaches_tried.reason: Phase 1's own Verification bullet requires LEAN_PLAN_COMPLIANCE_HARVESTER pointed at a nonexistent path to produce the fully-unresolved fail-soft outcome ([MISSING]/failed/exit 1). A full cascade instead silently fell through to the source-store sibling rung (which always exists when running from the source store), so the override had no observable effect -- the deliberate test seam was defeated. Fixed by making an explicitly-set override terminal: used if readable, else treated as unresolved outright, never falling through to the remaining rungs. This matches lean-comparator-run.sh's own env-override-with-sibling-default precedent, where the override (when set) is used as-is with no existence-check fallback.

notes: Suite baseline at this dispatch's live re-read was 22 passed, 0 failed (C1-C19, C21, C22), not the plan-time-measured 19 -- sibling task #504 landed commits adding C21/C22 since the plan was written. Re-verified unchanged (still 22/22) after this phase's edits, per the pre-write re-read obligation rather than trusting the stale plan-time figure.

Scratch end-to-end reproduction in the session scratchpad (p1repro/) confirmed: (a) the unmodified script (git show HEAD) reports [MISSING] probeOnly / failed / exit 1 against the probe fixture, reproducing the originating defect; (b) the fixed script reports [OK] probeOnly / passed / exit 0 against the same fixture; (c) a genuinely absent name still reports [MISSING]/failed/exit 1; (d) LEAN_PLAN_COMPLIANCE_HARVESTER pointed at a nonexistent path returns to (a)'s roots-only outcome with exactly one fail-soft NOTE on stderr.
